name: @idosgames/module-sdk
description: The composable-module contract for the iDosGames host shell: Module / ModuleContext types plus tiny authoring helpers. Framework-neutral at runtime вЂ” a module can be a game (Three/Phaser), a plain app, or an AI app.
author: iDos Games
